description: Changes how the variants' own emails are sent, as the app's Burst settings in its Emailing tab do: only the settings passed, on the template, whose settings new variants copy, and on the variants. Each keeps its recipients: set them with updateBurstVariantRecipients. Sends no email. Members who only contribute change their own variants. See a report's settings with getReportEmailConfig.

body.description: What the tool creates, changes or sends

emailAnalyticsEnabled.description: Whether to track when recipients open the emails. `true` returns 403 unless email analytics is on for the organization. If omitted, stays as it is.

groupRecipients.description: Whether each variant sends one email to all its `to` addresses together, rather than one email per address. If omitted, stays as it is.

ignoredFailureStatusMessages.description:
The failures that shouldn't stop a run from emailing a variant (see `trigger`), such as the `error.code` values from `listReportSyncs`. If omitted, stays as it is.

The other values describe why a sync of an older report failed, and have an effect only on older reports:

- `dashboard_not_found`, or the older `tableau_view_not_found`: the dashboard, Tableau workbook, Power BI report or spreadsheet could not be found.
- `dashboard_tab_not_found`: the dashboard tab, Tableau view, Power BI report page or spreadsheet sheet could not be found.
- `dashboard_not_ready`: the dashboard took too long to load.
- `dashboard_has_errors`: the dashboard or spreadsheet failed to load because of an error in the tool it comes from.
- `dashboard_invalid_layout`: the dashboard's layout is invalid, and it needs to be saved again.
- `element_not_found`, or the older `metabase_element_not_found` and `looker_element_not_found`: the visualization could not be found.
- `slide_not_found`, or the older `google_slide_not_found`: the slide that shows the visualization could not be found.
- `file_not_found`: the spreadsheet file the visualization comes from could not be found.
- `sheet_not_found`: the spreadsheet sheet could not be found.
- `sheet_hidden`: the spreadsheet sheet is hidden and needs to be unhidden.
- `range_not_found`: the spreadsheet range could not be found.
- `duplicate_file_failed`: Rollstack could not prepare the spreadsheet file for the update.
- `merged_range_on_filter_range`: the visualization has merged cells, which filters can't be applied to.
- `insufficient_permissions`: the owner doesn't have edit access to the file.
- `image_cropping_failed`: Rollstack could not crop the visualization's image.
- `visualization_not_found`: the visualization could not be found in the dashboard.
- `visualization_not_ready`: the visualization took too long to load.
- `visualization_has_errors`: the visualization failed to load because of an error in the tool it comes from.
- `visualization_empty`, or the older `empty_data`: the visualization is empty.
- `invalid_credentials`: the connection's credentials are invalid.
- `missing_credentials`: the connection's credentials were deleted, or the owner's access to it was suspended.
- `instance_unavailable`: the data source's instance is temporarily unavailable.
- `column_not_found`: a column the native chart uses is missing from its data.
- `fetch_summary_data_error`, `fetch_visual_specification_error`, `missing_data`, `missing_formatted_value` and `viz_not_ready`: Rollstack could not fetch the data of a native chart.
- `incorrect_data_structure`: the native chart's structure doesn't fit its data.
- `malformed_data`: Rollstack could not fetch the data of a native chart or, from Snowflake or Databricks, the query is invalid.
- `worksheet_not_found`: the Tableau worksheet could not be found.
- `sync_not_found`: the visualization was deleted.
- `file_update_failed`: the data was fetched but could not be written into the file.

sendAttachmentAsLink.description: Whether the email puts the `pdf` or `ppt` file behind a Download PDF or Download PPT button instead of attaching it. When `false`, the file is attached. Has no effect with `cloudLink`. If omitted, stays as it is.

sharingFormat.description: How the email delivers the report. `pdf` and `ppt` send it as a PDF or PowerPoint file, attached or behind a download button (see `sendAttachmentAsLink`); a slide deck leaves its hidden slides out. `link` sends a link to the Google Drive or OneDrive file an older report updates, shared with the recipients as set in the app; an email report sends its content in the email itself, and a slide deck has no such file, so one whose settings still contain `link` is emailed as a PDF behind a download button. `cloudLink` (Exported link in the app), for slide decks only, sends a link to the copy exported to Google Drive or OneDrive and shares it with the addresses in `to`, `cc` and `bcc` with the sharing permission set in the app, viewer unless changed there; if no permission is set, as after PDF or PPT was picked in the app, the copy isn't shared with them. If omitted, stays as it is.

smtpServerId.description: The SMTP connection to send the emails through, from `listSmtpConnections`; `null` sends from Rollstack's own address. If omitted, each report keeps its own sender.

trigger.description: Which of the report's runs email it automatically. A run emails it when it updates everything, or when all its failures are in `ignoredFailureStatusMessages`. On a slide deck, `all` and `scheduled` work the same way: only runs started by its schedules (see `getReportSchedules`) send the email, and a slide deck with no datasheets is never emailed by its runs. On an older report, `all` emails after every run of the whole report, whether started by a schedule, with `startReportRun` or in the app, and `scheduled` only after runs its schedules start; a run of only some syncs never emails it. With `none` (Manual in the app), no run sends it: the email goes out only when sent with `sendReportEmail` or from the app. If omitted, stays as it is.

variantIds.description: The reports to change, by their `id`: variants from `listBurstVariants`, and the burst's `templateReportId`, whose settings new variants copy. If omitted, the template and every variant you can edit.

idempotencyKey.description: A unique value, such as a UUID, that makes retrying this call safe. A retry with the same key within 24 hours answers the first call's result instead of running it again. Use a new key for each new call. From 1 to 255 printable ASCII characters.

params.description: The ids of what the tool acts on

id.description: The burst to act on, by its `id` from `listBursts`. You can also copy it from the burst's link in Rollstack: it's the part right after `/collections/`.

name: updateBurstVariantEmailSettings
title: Set variant email settings
